notes: Six-question check: economy decelerating, profits unclear, mood scared in equities but credit (HYG/LQD) calm and bonds not rallying despite the selloff — that's a dollar-driven deleveraging, not classic flight-to-quality panic. Gold down over a fifth in three months and oil down nearly a fifth in a month look like a crowded trade unwinding, not yet showing signs of stopping. Quality names like Coke, Johnson & Johnson and [redacted] already rallied while the market fell, so buying them now chases a move everyone already sees. VIX near twenty-six is elevated but not the panic reading of true despair. No clean cycle-position signal yet in either direction, so no edge to act on; staying in cash is the disciplined move while the pendulum keeps swinging.
